bundle.shortDescription: Local, zero-cloud game clipping and replay buffer for Windows
bundle.longDescription: replayed keeps the last 30-120 seconds of gameplay in a ring buffer and writes a lossless clip to disk the instant you press a hotkey or your game reports an event. No account, no telemetry, no cloud upload, no Overwolf runtime. Windows 10 1903+ / Windows 11, x86_64, with a hardware encoder (NVENC, QuickSync or AMF).
